Riverside Vet Clinic cares for both healthy and sick animals at our clinic in Donalsonville. We see your pets at your convenience. Just walk-in! As a walk-in hospital, appointments are needed only for scheduled surgeries, dentals, and boarding. Our caring team is dedicated to providing you with the most comfortable place to bring your pet(s), and we are committed to making each visit the best experience it can be. From spay and neuter procedures to boarding, we proudly offer a host of outstanding services at reasonable rates. We've been Donalsonville's top choice for over 30 years! Explore our website to learn more about our veterinary practice, so we can meet you and your pet!

If you have any questions, call 229-524-6198 or contact us and we'll promptly get back to you.
